# m.futures.products

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Futures products: the specification of every product, the family of its contracts.

Call it from a session `m`, made with `dm.MassiveSession()`:

```python
m.futures.products(*, product_code=None, as_of=None, sort=None, order=None, limit=None, filters=None)
```

- [Query methods](README.md#query-methods): `fetch()`, `poll(interval)`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `ProductCode`, `TradingVenue` and `Date`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

A linked argument follows the [shared rules](README.md#shared-arguments) on the dataset index.

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `product_code` | Only this product (`"ES"`) or these (`["ES", "NQ"]`); None for every product. A table of codes, in a `ProductCode` column, reads each code as if passed alone; a live one is followed by `fetch()` and re-read by each `poll()` cycle. |
| [`as_of`](README.md#as_of) | The day whose specifications to list; None for today. |
| [`sort`](README.md#sort) | Such as `"name"`; the endpoint sorts by `date`. Fields: any REST field under [Massive fields](#massive-fields). |
| [`order`](README.md#order) | Needs `sort`. |
| [`limit`](README.md#limit) | The most rows to return, in total. |
| [`filters`](README.md#filters) | Such as `{"sector": "precious"}` or `{"trading_venue": "XCME"}`. Keys: `asset_class`, `asset_class_any_of`, `asset_sub_class`, `asset_sub_class_any_of`, `name`, `name_any_of`, `name_gt`, `name_gte`, `name_lt`, `name_lte`, `provider_id`, `sector`, `sector_any_of`, `sub_sector`, `sub_sector_any_of`, `trading_venue`, `trading_venue_any_of`, `trading_venue_gt`, `trading_venue_gte`, `trading_venue_lt`, `trading_venue_lte`, `type`, `type_any_of`. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Products (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Futures Basic | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Futures Starter | Updated daily, 2 years |
| Futures Developer | Updated daily, 5 years |
| Futures Advanced | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business CME | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business CBOT | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business NYMEX | Updated daily, All history |
| Futures Business COMEX | Updated daily, All history |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AssetClass` | String | The asset class to which the product belongs. |
| `AssetSubClass` | String | The asset sub-class to which the product belongs. |
| `ClearingSymbol` | String | The clearing symbol assigned to this product by the exchange's clearing house. |
| `ClearingVenue` | String | The exchange identifier for the clearing house that clears this product's contracts. |
| `Date` | String | The day, YYYY-MM-DD, whose point-in-time state the row describes. |
| `LastUpdated` | Instant | The date and time at which this product was last updated. |
| `Name` | String | The full name of the product. |
| `PriceQuotation` | String | The quoted price for this product. |
| `ProductCode` | String | The identifier for the product. |
| `ProviderId` | String | A unique identifier for the product assigned by the data provider. Can be used to distinguish products that share a product code. |
| `Sector` | String | The sector to which the product belongs. |
| `SettlementCurrencyCode` | String | The currency in which this product settles. |
| `SettlementMethod` | String | The method of settlement for this product (Financially Settled or Deliverable). |
| `SettlementType` | String | The type of settlement for this product. |
| `StrategyType` | String | The strategy type for combo products (e.g. calendar, butterfly, strip). Null for single products. |
| `SubSector` | String | The sub-sector to which the product belongs. |
| `TradeCurrencyCode` | String | The currency in which this product's contracts trade. |
| `TradingVenue` | String | The trading venue (MIC) for the exchange on which this product's contracts trade. |
| `Type` | String | The type of product, one of 'single' or 'combo'. Leaving this filter blank will query for both 'single' and 'combo' types. |
| `UnitOfMeasure` | String | The unit of measure for this product. |
| `UnitOfMeasureQty` | double | The quantity of the unit of measure for this product. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant, by the local clock. Every row of one REST page shares it. It isn't Massive's time, and it isn't monotonic. In a `poll()` table, it's the latest poll's time. |
